title: Two marine heatwaves compared: 2015-2016 and 2017-2018
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature and CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), compare the marine heatwaves of 2015-2016 and 2017-2018: their extent, intensity, duration and timing, how chlorophyll responded, and why the two events differed. Justify your heatwave definition and baseline. The two products come from different model systems; account for that.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
